meta.title: Dust To Dust
meta.description: "Joy and sorrow are hidden in the heart. They are smaller than specks of dust and lighter than a feather, yet they shine brighter than the stars and enrich the life that has them."

units.rawText: Jiutian sector, aboard the flagship of the Jovian Ringworld Fleet.
units.displayText: Jiutian sector, aboard the flagship of the Jovian Ringworld Fleet.

spans.text: Jiutian sector, aboard the flagship of the Jovian Ringworld Fleet.

spans.text: Lord Yuwang, the comets will eventually break through the Ringworld's blockade. We can't keep this up.

units.rawText: Their lines are disintegrating and his friends are dying. Ill news keeps streaming in from the front, constantly reminding Yuwang of the cruelty of this battle.
units.displayText: Their lines are disintegrating and his friends are dying. Ill news keeps streaming in from the front, constantly reminding Yuwang of the cruelty of this battle.

spans.text: Their lines are disintegrating and his friends are dying. Ill news keeps streaming in from the front, constantly reminding Yuwang of the cruelty of this battle.

units.rawText: I thought it all stemmed from those HD Entropics... But in the end I forgot that it was just a function of the sector's base layer logic and that ALL the planets were the source of the Heat Death...

units.rawText: He chose to pin his last hopes on me, even though he knew there was nothing I could do.

units.rawText: Lord Yuwang... I—no, we have an idea.
units.displayText: Lord Yuwang... I—no, we have an idea.

spans.text: Lord Yuwang... I—no, we have an idea.

units.rawText: If the Ringworld is going to be entropized... then why not fight to the death rather than await our fate?!
units.displayText: If the Ringworld is going to be entropized... then why not fight to the death rather than await our fate?!

spans.text: If the Ringworld is going to be entropized... then why not fight to the death rather than await our fate?!

units.rawText: We are all prepared to give up everything to keep the flame burning. It might be a foolish course of action, but it is the last act of faith for all the agents of Jiutian sector!
units.displayText: We are all prepared to give up everything to keep the flame burning. It might be a foolish course of action, but it is the last act of faith for all the agents of Jiutian sector!

spans.text: We are all prepared to give up everything to keep the flame burning. It might be a foolish course of action, but it is the last act of faith for all the agents of Jiutian sector!

units.rawText: Wait, are you going to—
units.displayText: Wait, are you going to—

spans.text: Wait, are you going to—

units.rawText: Since we can't deploy the blockade because of the entropization, then we'll just have to use the Ringworld to clear our path.
units.displayText: Since we can't deploy the blockade because of the entropization, then we'll just have to use the Ringworld to clear our path.

spans.text: Since we can't deploy the blockade because of the entropization, then we'll just have to use the Ringworld to clear our path.

units.rawText: There are still around 50 or so operational power plants around the Ringworld. They contain a massive amount of operands, enough to instantly destroy the Jovian entropics if we set them off.
units.displayText: There are still around 50 or so operational power plants around the Ringworld. They contain a massive amount of operands, enough to instantly destroy the Jovian entropics if we set them off.

spans.text: There are still around 50 or so operational power plants around the Ringworld. They contain a massive amount of operands, enough to instantly destroy the Jovian entropics if we set them off.

spans.text: Unwilling to meekly submit to their fate, they have chosen to struggle against the mightiest force in the universe!

units.displayText: The massive, crushing pressure makes Yuwang feel like his body has frozen up.

spans.text: The massive, crushing pressure makes Yuwang feel like his body has frozen up.

units.displayText: Ever since Belka was born in Jiutian, I knew this would be my home forever.

spans.text: Ever since Belka was born in Jiutian, I knew this would be my home forever.

units.rawText: Whether as an agent, or as dust, debris, or wreckage. Thank you for protecting this place to the very end, Lord Yuwang...
